content: Abadâhwa n'Abaleviti bayâgaluka amango ga Zorobabeli na Yozwè
Alaga omurhwe gw’abadâhwa n’abaleviti bayâgalukaga kuguma na Zorobabeli mugala wa Shealtieli boshi na Yozwè: Seraya, Yirmeya, Ezra.
Amarya, Maluku, Hatushi,
Shekanya, Rehumu, Meremoti,
Ido, Ginetoyi, Abiya,
Miyamini, Maadya, Bilga,
Shemaya, Yoyaribu, Yedaya.
Salu, Amok, Hilkiya, Yedaya; abo boshi bâli bakulu ba badâhwa amango ga Yozwè kuguma na bene wâbo.
Abaleviti: Yozwè, Binuwi, Kadmiyeli, Sherebiya, Yehuda, Matanya, ye wali oyimanzibwe kuguma na bene wâbo oku nyimbo z’okukuza Nyamuzinda.
Bakubukiya, Uni, bene wâbo bali balanzi, bali bagwêrhe omukolo gw’okukabashuza, okukabayankirira.
Iburha ly’Abadâhwa bakulu
Yozwè aburha Yoyakimu, Yoyakimu aburha Eliyashibu, Eliyashibu aburha Yoyada.
Yoyada aburha Yônatani; na Yehanani aburha Yaduwa.
Alaga omu badâhwa bâli bakulu b’emilala amango ga Yoyakimu: kuli Seraya, Meraya; kuli Yirmeya, ali Hananiya;
kuli Ezra, Meshulami; kuli Amariyali, Yohâna;
kuli Meliki, àli Yônatani; kuli Shebanya, àli Yozefu; kuli Harimu, Adena;
kuli Merayoti Helkayi;
kuli Ido, Zakariya; kuli Ginetoni, Meshulami;
kuli Abiya, Zikiri; kuli Minyamini; Kuli Moadiya, Piltayi;
kuli Bilga, Shamuwa; kuli Shemaya, Yônatani;
kuli Yoyaribu, Matenayi; kuli Yedaya, ali Uzi;
kuli Salayi, Kalayi; kuli Amoki, Eberi;
kuli Hilkiya, Hashabiya; kuli Yedaya, Netaneli.
Omu mango ga Eliyashibu, aga Yoyada; aga Yohanani; abaleviti abakulu b’emilala y’abadâhwa bayandikwa omu citabu c’enganîro kuhika kuli Dariusi w’omu Persi.
Bene Levi, abàli bakulu b’emilala banaciyandikwa omu citabu c’Enganîro kuhika oku mango ga Eliyashibu gône.

Abakulu b’abaleviti: Hashabya, Meshulamu na Yozwè, mugala wa Kadmiyeli ye wal’igwêrhe omukolo, kuguma na bene wâbo, okukâkuza n’okushenga Nyamuzinda nka kulya Daudi muntu wa Nnâmahanga anarhegekaga, cigamba ciguma cikâyîmbiza, ecindi cikâshuza.
Mataniya, Bakubukiya, Obadiya, Meshulamu, Talmoni na Akubu, bo bâli balanzi b’emihango; bakâg’ibêra oku c’olusò c’enyumvi.
Bakozire ntyo omu mango ga Yoyakimu mugala wa Yozwè, mwene Yosadaki n’omu mango ga Nehemiya ye wali murhambo na Ezra ye wali mudâhwa na mwandisi.
Okugisha ebyôgo bya Yeruzalemu

Erhi bakola bagisha ebyo byôgo bya Yeruzalemu, balâlika abaleviti boshi, ngasi aha banayûbakaga mpu bayîshe aha Yeruzalemu lyo bageza olwo lusiku lukulu omu busîme n’enyimbo z’okukuza, zazihwa, n’ennanga n’enzenze.
Bagala b’abimbiza nabo b’omu bishagala by’eburhambi bwa Yeruzalemu bashûbûzanya; byo birigi bishagala bya Netofayasi,
Bet-ha-Gilgal n’omu cihugo ca Geba na Azemaveti, ebwa kubà abo bîmbiza bayûbasire ngasi baguma olwâbo lugo omu marhambi ga Yeruzalemu.
Abadâhwa n’abaleviti erhi babà bamaciyôbôla n’olubaga, bakangûla olugurhu n’emihango.
Nashoneza abaluzi ba bene Yûda boshi kuli lulya lugurhu, abantu nabo bajira nkere ibiri oku lugendo lutagatîfu. Olukere lwa burhanzi lwayîsha ebwa kulyo kw’olugurhu olunda lw’omuhango.
Enyuma lyâbo yayisha Hoshaya na cigabi ciguma ca baluzi ba bene Yûda
Azariya, Ezra, Meshulamu, Yehuda,
Shemaya, Benyamini, Yirmeya,
bagala b’abadâhwa bayisha n’emishekera, bali gi: Zakariya, mugala wa Yônatani, mugala wa Shemaya, mugala wa Matanya, mugala wa Mikanya, mugala wa Zakuru, mugala wa Asafi na bene wâbo.
Shemaya, Azareli, Milalayi, Maayi, Natanaeli, Yûda na Hanani bâli badwîrhe ebirugu Daudi akâg’ikolêsa oku nzihwa. Omwandisi Abashokolera.

Aha muhango gw’Amaliba, basôka, n’aha mbêre zâbo hàli amashonezo g’olugo lwa Daudi, bagera oku lugurhu burherema enyanya ly’enyumpa ya Daudi kuhika aha muhango gw’Amîshi olunda lw’ebushoshôkero bw’izûba.
Ecigamba ca kabiri cabugânana n’eca burhanzi; nal’inciyîmanzize na cigabi ciguma ca lubaga okwo lugurhu. Kurhenga oku nyanya lya enkingi y’amatabâro, lwagenzekanwa kuhika aha lugurhu lwàli lugali.

Kandi kurhenga oku nyanya ly’omuhango gwa Efrayimu, kuhika oku muhango Mîra, oku muhango gwa Enfî; kurhenga oku cigamba ca Hananeli n’oku muhango gwa Meya kuhika oku muhango gw’Ebibuzi; baj’iyîmanga aha muhango gw’e mpamikwa.
Birya bigamba byombi byaj’iyîmanga omu ka-Nyamuzinda, na nâni erhi ndi haguma n’ecihimbi c’abakulu b’abatwî b’emmanja bali rhweshi haguma n’aba:
abadâhwa Elyakim, Maseya, Minyamini, Mikaya, Eliyehoyenayi, Zakariya, Hananiya, boshi n’emishekera
haguma na Maseya, Shemaya, Eleazari, Yehohanani, Elamu, Ezeri, Malkiya, Ananiya. Abayimba nabo bayumvikana, bâli bayimangîrwe na Yizirahya.

Olwo lusiku bahêra enterekêro nkulu, basîma bulya Nyamuzinda abashagalusize n’obusîme bunene. Abakazi n’abâna bâbo basîma bwenêne. Ecihôgêro c’obushagaluke calumira omu Yeruzalemu, cayumvikana ciru na kuli bwenêne.
Amango g’omuhigo nkana

Ago mango enyumpa y’okubîkiramwo ebiryo, ebisârûlwa birhangiriza, n’entûlo, bayihirakwo abalanzi mpu bakaz’iyilundikamwo ebigabi bidwirhirwe abadâhwa bene-Levi; bigabi byakâg’irhenga omu bishagala byoshi, nk’oku byanal’irhegesirwe. Bulya Yûda ali asîmire okubona abadâhwa n’abaleviti bo shi bali omu mikolo yâbo.
Bakazâg’ijira emikolo ya Nyamuzinda wâbo, n’enterekêro y’okuyobôka kuguma n’abimbiza n’abalanzi b’emihango nk’oku Daudi anali arhegesire n’omugala Salomoni.
Bulya mîra omu mango ga Daudi n’aga Asafi, hali omurhambo w’abimbiza b’enyimbo z’okuharâmya n’okuvuga omunkwa emwa Nnâmahanga.

Israheli yêshi omu mango ga Zerobabeli n’aga Nehemiya, bakazâg’ihâna ecigabi c’abimbiza n’ec’abalanzi b’emihango; nabo abaleviti bakâhâbwa entûlo ntagatîfu, abaleviti nabo kuli cirya cigabi câbo, banahàkwo bene Aroni.
